lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field surveys to collect Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) data across Zimbabwe administrative units. IPC classifications were spatially mapped and compiled into geographic datasets for February, June, and October 2019 near-term projections, representing food insecurity impact assessments in response to drought conditions.
